items.description: Scale’s rapidly growing Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of: Creating custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens Generating high-quality training data for national LLMs Upskilling and advisory services to spread the impact of AI We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced product leader to play a pivotal role in the ideation and development of transformative AI solutions for government and government-backed customers across the Middle East. The ideal candidate has deep experience building AI/ML applications, thinks strategically about how to solve a problem, is an excellent listener, is comfortable getting into the weeds, and has a strong understanding of software engineering principles and practices. You will own large AI projects end to end, working directly with customers and leading a cross-functional team of engineers, MLEs, and operators to deliver solutions that drive meaningful impact for our customers and significant revenue for our business. You will: Lead design workshops with clients to define custom AI solutions Scope new AI application use cases across government entities, and turn them into a clear roadmap, phasing, and success metrics Build MVPs and demos to validate ideas quickly, and take the best of them to production Lead cross-functional development with diverse stakeholders (Engineering, MLE, Operations, and Go-to-Market) Engage consistently with end users to gather feedback and ensure we are prioritizing effectively Scope model evaluation sets and performance requirements, review results, and iterate on the solution Stay up to date with the latest research in applied AI and training custom LLMs Give regular progress updates to the client and Global Public Sector leadership Ideally, you’d have: 4+ years of experience building products, including 1–2+ years building AI-powered products in production Strong technical background (STEM degree) and/or experience building technical software products Hands-on experience with LLMs and applied AI, and a strong understanding of generative AI in enterprise settings Sharp product sense and customer instinct: the conviction to take a position and defend it, and the judgment to change it when the evidence says so Comfort with client-facing work and the pace and ambiguity of a forward-deployed team Experience with vibe coding tools (e.g., Replit, Lovable, Bolt) and design tools (e.g., Figma, Canva, Miro) Exceptional leadership, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams Nice to haves: Proficiency in Arabic, both written and spoken Coding experience (Python) Prior experience as a founder, founding engineer, or forward-deployed PM Experience working with government or GCC customers PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. About Us: At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications. We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's Know Your Rights poster for additional information. We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision . PLEASE NOTE: We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our privacy policy for additional information.

items.title: Recruiter, Applied AI
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is seeking a strategic Go-To-Market Recruiter specializing in Applied AI to join our GTM recruiting organization. In this role, you'll focus specifically on building and scaling our Applied AI team - the Pre-Sales architects and technical advisors who help large enterprises successfully integrate and deploy Claude. Working within our broader GTM recruiting team, you'll drive full-cycle recruiting for these critical customer-facing technical roles that bridge our cutting-edge AI technology with real-world business applications. This specialized role requires deep technical recruiting expertise combined with a strong understanding of enterprise SaaS and AI landscapes. You'll collaborate closely with GTM recruiting colleagues while developing targeted strategies for the unique talent needs of our Applied AI organization. You'll help shape how enterprises work with AI systems by building teams that directly influence the safe and beneficial deployment of Claude across industries. Key responsibilities Lead end-to-end recruiting for Applied AI team roles, including Solutions Architects, Pre-Sales Engineers, front-line managers and other customer-facing technical positions Partner with Applied AI leadership and GTM recruiting colleagues to develop comprehensive hiring strategies that align with overall GTM objectives Execute sophisticated sourcing strategies to identify candidates with rare combinations of technical depth, customer empathy, and business acumen Create exceptional candidate experiences that showcase Anthropic's mission and the unique opportunity to shape enterprise AI adoption Build pipelines of talent with expertise in LLMs, cloud architecture, enterprise software integration, and technical consulting Collaborate with GTM recruiting team members to share best practices, market insights, and cross-functional candidate leads Leverage Claude and other AI tools to enhance recruiting efficiency while maintaining high-touch, personalized engagement Provide data-driven insights on compensation trends and talent availability specific to the Applied AI market Minimum qualifications Excel at recruiting for customer-facing technical roles that require both deep technical knowledge and exceptional communication skills Understand the technical requirements of roles working with LLMs, APIs, cloud architectures, and enterprise system integration Thrive in collaborative environments, working seamlessly with GTM recruiting colleagues while managing specialized searches Can effectively assess candidates' abilities to translate complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders Have a track record of building trusted advisor relationships with technical hiring managers Are passionate about using AI to transform recruiting practices while maintaining a human-centered approach Preferred qualifications Have 5+ years of technical or technical sales recruiting experience, ideally within GTM organizations at enterprise software or AI/ML companies Direct experience recruiting for pre-sales/solutions engineering roles in the AI/ML space Demonstrated success working within GTM recruiting organizations during periods of hypergrowth Expertise in developing specialized recruiting practices within broader team structures Familiarity with the challenges of deploying AI systems in enterprise environments Experience collaborating across recruiting teams to share resources and best practices A technical background or successful track record recruiting for highly specialized technical positions The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $175,000 — $240,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Network Development Engineer, WAN & Edge
items.location_text: Paris, Amsterdam, Warsaw, Munich, London, Berlin
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Network Development Engineer - WAN & Edge, you will design, automate, and operate resilient connectivity between data centers, cloud environments, external networks, and the internet. Your work will span routing, firewalls, traffic engineering, and production troubleshooting. This is a hands-on role for an experienced network engineer who can build, test, debug, and review production-grade automation. Networking depth and strong software-engineering judgment matter more than familiarity with any particular language, platform, or tool. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and evolve resilient inter-site, cloud, and internet connectivity for large-scale AI infrastructure. - Own external BGP policy and traffic engineering at the edge, including route filtering, failover, and capacity planning. - Build API-driven automation for edge routing, firewalls, VPNs, carrier connectivity, and network segmentation. - Coordinate with carriers, cloud connectivity providers, colocation partners, and vendors on design, provisioning, incident escalation, and service improvement. - Design safe change workflows with automated validation and resilience testing, staged rollouts, observability, rollback, and recovery. - Participate in on-call rotation, troubleshoot active WAN and edge incidents, restore service, and turn root causes into lasting improvements. - Review designs and code, explain networking trade-offs, and help raise network engineering quality across the organization. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Deep, hands-on WAN and edge networking experience across internet connectivity, data-center interconnect, private WAN, or cloud networking. - A track record of taking external BGP designs from whiteboard to production and debugging them during production incidents. - Experience integrating and troubleshooting stateful firewalls, NAT, asymmetric routing, and redundant edge designs on at least one major routing or firewall platform. - Experience building or operating production network automation using network-management APIs and data models. You understand desired state and idempotency; relevant technologies might include REST, NETCONF, gNMI/OpenConfig, Ansible, or Terraform. - Strong software-engineering fundamentals in a general-purpose language. You can design, test, debug, and review production systems and are willing to become productive in Go. - Operational troubleshooting experience using routing and flow state, packet captures, link health, telemetry, and logs to diagnose production incidents. - Clear, pragmatic communication and effective stakeholder management. You can translate technical needs into connectivity designs and provider requirements, define acceptance criteria and service-level expectations, and provide technical leadership. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with FortiGate, FortiManager, or comparable edge and firewall platforms. - Deeper specialization in external connectivity, such as public-cloud or hybrid-cloud interconnect, or internet transit and peering. - Exposure to edge security and scale techniques such as RPKI and route-origin validation, DDoS mitigation, or global traffic engineering. - Familiarity with streaming telemetry, network source-of-truth systems, and configuration-compliance tooling. - Experience reading, reviewing, or contributing to Go code. - Familiarity with Kubernetes controllers, operators, or other declarative, reconciliation-based systems. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

You will apply deep networking expertise to leaf-spine architecture, automation, testing, and production troubleshooting across Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRFs. This is a hands-on role for a networking expert who is also comfortable building production software. Go and Kubernetes experience are helpful but not required; strong engineering fundamentals and network automation experience matter more. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and evolve leaf-spine underlays, EVPN/VXLAN overlays, and tenant connectivity for multi-tenant AI infrastructure. - Translate data-center fabric requirements and safety properties into clear APIs, data models, validation, and automation. - Build reliable control-plane software that reconciles desired and observed network state. - Design safe change workflows with validation, dry runs, atomic updates, observability, and failure recovery. - Integrate with data-center switch operating systems and management APIs while maintaining vendor-neutral abstractions where practical. - Participate in the on-call rotation, troubleshoot active data-center network incidents, restore service, and turn root causes into lasting improvements. - Review designs and code, explain networking trade-offs, and help raise network engineering quality across the organization. - Develop lab and production tests and turn operational lessons into better software and architecture. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Deep hands-on experience with Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP-based leaf-spine fabrics, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRF-based multitenancy. - Strong judgment around fabric underlay and overlay design, scale, convergence, isolation, and failure modes. - Experience building or operating production network automation, including desired state, idempotency, concurrency, observability, and recovery. - Strong software-engineering fundamentals in a general-purpose language. You can design, test, debug, and review production systems and are willing to become productive in Go. - Experience with southbound network APIs and structured configuration, such as REST, gNMI/OpenConfig, or NETCONF. - Hands-on experience with major data-center network operating systems, such as Cumulus Linux, Arista EOS, SONiC, Junos, or NX-OS. - Strong diagnostic skills using routing and EVPN state, packet captures, counters, telemetry, and logs. - Clear, pragmatic communication and a collaborative approach to technical leadership. NICE TO HAVE - Experience reading, reviewing, or contributing to Go code. - Familiarity with Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, reconciliation, or Kubebuilder. - Experience with physical or simulated network labs such as containerlab, NVIDIA Air, EVE-NG, GNS3, or similar environments. - Experience with high-performance Ethernet, RoCE, InfiniBand, HPC, or large-scale GPU infrastructure. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. items.title: IT Support Engineer
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an IT Support Engineer based out of our Warsaw office. This is a hybrid role - 4 days per week on-site and one day working from home. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Device lifecycle management: assist with laptop procurement, setup, returns, and secure wiping - Office IT support: provide on-hand support to our colleagues in our Warsaw office, as well as support with expansions and/or office buildouts - AV support: ensure meeting rooms and AV equipment are running reliably - End-user support: be the first point of contact for the team by logging, prioritising and resolving support tickets in a timely manner, keeping end users informed throughout. - Onboarding: run IT onboarding calls for new joiners - New IT projects: contribute to IT initiatives - Automation and tooling: build automations and Slack bots to streamline repetitive work - Documentation: write and maintain clear internal IT documentation and guides (fixes, processes and playbooks) to continue building out our internal knowledge base WHAT YOU BRING - A friendly, end-user focused attitude. You genuinely enjoy helping people solve problems. - Strong organisational skills, attention to details and a proactive mindset. - Solid IT fundamentals (macOS, iOS and Android Operating systems, networking basics, SaaS tooling, AV systems etc.) - Hands-on experience with an MDM platform (Jamf, Kandji, Fleet or similar) - Experience with Okta (or similar IdP) and understanding of access management principles, SSO, MFA and user/group management. - A willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly - Clear written and verbal communication skills with a knack for writing helpful documentation. BONUS - Prior experience in a high growth / startup environment - Experience in a customer or public-facing role - Experience with Agentic AI tooling - Familiarity with bash scripting WHAT WE OFFER At ElevenLabs, our biggest reward is shaping that future of voice technology. In addition, we offer: - Stock options; we want you to have ownership in the company and share the successes that lie ahead. That’s why we offer early employees stock options as part of their compensation package. - Extraordinary team; we favor ambitious, smart people striving for outsized impact. You’ll work on the state of the art surrounded by people with extraordinary skills and positive attitudes. - We offer competitive compensation and stock options. We are open to candidates of varying seniority. Given the broad range, we'll be happy to discuss specific salary details during our initial conversation. - Annual company off-sites; the last ones were in Croatia, Portugal and Switzerland. This position will be 4 days on-site in our Warsaw office. items.title: Full Stack Engineer - Growth & Experimentation – Krak
items.location_text: Brazil, Uruguay, Peru, Colombia, Argentina, Paraguay, Mexico, Chile
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join a small, dedicated growth and experimentation team within Krak, focused on accelerating acquisition, activation, engagement and trading activity across the Krak app. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: the majority of your work will be in React Native, supported by enough backend capability to take an experiment from idea to live without waiting on another team. Rather than executing against a rigid roadmap, you’ll work closely with Product on a continuous pipeline of fast, lightweight experiments, owning each one from hypothesis through implementation, launch, measurement and iteration. The mandate is simple: find the highest-leverage opportunities to grow users and revenue, prove what works, and scale the winners – with direct, measurable impact on how millions of customers discover and use Kraken’s products. The opportunity - Build and ship consumer-facing features quickly in React Native and TypeScript, favouring small, high-velocity experiments over long-running projects. - Own experiments end-to-end – hypothesis, design, build, launch, measurement and iteration – using platforms such as Statsig to test globally or within specific markets. - Improve onboarding, activation and feature discovery to drive conversion, engagement and trading revenue, iterating rapidly on features that are already live. - Build viral acquisition features and value-add growth features on top of Krak’s existing product offering. - Contribute to backend services and APIs wherever an experiment requires it, so you can ship across the stack without being blocked. Our backend is primarily Rust; prior Rust experience is not expected, but enthusiasm for picking it up is. - Read your own results, including trade-offs between conversion gains and other metrics, and decide whether to scale, iterate or kill – driving technical decisions autonomously amid evolving priorities and limited upfront planning. What you bring - 3+ years of software development experience building and shipping large-scale, consumer-facing applications. Strong, hands-on React and React Native experience is essential. - Demonstrated experience running growth experiments at consumer-facing businesses, with measurable impact on conversion, activation, retention or revenue. This is a consumer growth role, so B2B or platform-only backgrounds are not a fit. - Working backend proficiency: you can design and implement services and APIs yourself. We care about backend fundamentals rather than any particular language, and you should be open to working in Rust. - Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, with hands-on experience across APIs, WebSockets and real-time systems, mobile performance, testing, and modern development workflows. - Practical experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests – feature flags, statistical significance, product analytics, funnel and cohort data – with the judgement to act decisively on what the results show. - End-to-end ownership of product features and a strong product engineering mindset, with the initiative and adaptability to operate with minimal direction amid ambiguity and frequently changing priorities. Nice to haves - Customer-facing product experience within fintech, digital banking, payments, trading or crypto. - Hands-on experience with Statsig or a comparable experimentation platform, including regional and global rollouts. - Rust experience, given our backend stack. - SQL and self-serve analytics, so you can pull and interrogate your own data. - AI fluency. Familiarity with how AI tools and patterns have fundamentally shifted your development workflow and problem-solving approach. - Native mobile development (iOS/Android), distributed systems or microservices, or engineering within a hyperscaling consumer technology organisation. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Stay connected Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/krakenfx Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/ Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice

items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Coinbase is building the everything exchange to give retail customers access to crypto, equities trading, high-yield savings, borrowing, and lending. As Product Marketing Manager, EMEA, you will lead regional go-to-market strategy and execution for our consumer offerings, connecting Global Consumer product teams with International Marketing. Based in our London office, you will work with partners across Europe and the US to turn global product direction into locally relevant launches and campaigns across EMEA. What You’ll Do Lead consumer product launches across EMEA, from audience research and positioning through launch execution, adoption, and evaluation. Adapt global product strategies into regional marketing plans that reflect customer needs, market conditions, product availability, and local regulatory requirements. Shape audience segmentation, messaging, and value propositions that make complex products clear and relevant to retail customers. Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Growth, CRM, Data Analytics, and Legal/Compliance to align launch plans, customer communications, and the product experience. Deliver integrated campaigns across paid, owned, and partner channels to drive customer acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention. Test growth opportunities, including direct mail, events, and partnerships, using clear hypotheses and success measures. Improve campaign and lifecycle performance with Growth and Analytics partners, applying customer insights and test results to guide investment and scale effective approaches. Required Skills and Experience 5+ years of experience in product marketing, go-to-market strategy, or consumer growth marketing. Experience owning product launches or integrated marketing programs across multiple channels and customer lifecycle stages. Ability to translate complex products into clear positioning, customer benefits, and actionable marketing plans. Demonstrated success adapting global strategies for regional markets, influencing cross-functional partners, and delivering through ambiguity. Analytical skills, including defining success measures, interpreting campaign and customer data, and using findings to improve results. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience managing concurrent projects and coordinating stakeholders. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: Recruiter, GTM - Singapore
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is seeking a results-driven Go-To-Market (GTM) Recruiter to help establish and scale our teams across GTM functions in the APAC region. Based in Singapore, you'll be instrumental in our expansion, serving as one of the founding Recruiting hires in the region while building exceptional teams from the ground up. This role requires someone who can bridge cultural gaps, maintain Anthropic's high standards, and work collaboratively with our Business teams and leaders to establish our local presence. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and excels at building relationships across diverse cultural and business contexts. Key Responsibilities: Drive full-cycle recruiting for multiple GTM teams while establishing recruiting infrastructure and processes in APAC Develop culturally-informed sourcing strategies to attract top talent for Singapore, with potential expansion to broader APAC markets Partner with regional leaders and HQ to provide consultative guidance on talent acquisition strategy while adapting global practices for local markets Leverage AI tools, including Claude, to innovate recruiting processes and drive efficiency across time zones Provide market intelligence on compensation trends, talent availability, and cultural considerations while coaching hiring managers on regional best practices Serve as a cultural ambassador, ensuring candidates understand Anthropic's mission while advocating for regional talent needs with global leadership Build foundational recruiting processes, systems, and partnerships with local agencies, universities, and professional networks You may be a good fit if you: Have 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in high-growth GTM functions in APAC markets Excel at building processes from scratch while managing multiple concurrent searches in ambiguous environments Are passionate about leveraging technology and AI to transform recruiting processes Have exceptional communication skills with ability to work effectively across cultural contexts Demonstrate cultural sensitivity and ability to navigate complex stakeholder relationships across regions and time zones Have experience with data-driven recruiting and metrics-based performance tracking in international contexts Understand nuances of hiring practices, employment law, and professional norms in Singapore Have experience working with distributed teams across significant time zone differences Strong candidates may also: Have experience recruiting for AI or deep technology companies in APAC markets Demonstrate success in establishing recruiting functions during international expansion Show expertise in building company culture and employer brand in new markets Have established networks within Singapore’s technology ecosystem Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Legal Program Manager
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Legal team helps advance our mission by tackling novel legal issues in AI. Our team brings together professionals across technology, privacy, intellectual property, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. Our regulatory compliance work turns legal requirements into practical programs that support responsible AI development and deployment. About the Role As a Legal Program Manager, you will independently manage assigned programs and workstreams across Legal priorities, with a focus on emerging user risk. Your portfolio may include sensitive user escalations, intake and response workflows, and improvements informed by recurring issues, with the mix evolving alongside team needs. You will partner with counsel, senior legal program managers, and technical and business teams to establish priorities and scope, then drive day-to-day execution. You’ll organize information, coordinate partners, and move open questions toward decisions. As you develop expertise, you’ll take on more ambiguous projects and build repeatable processes that help teams work more effectively. This full-time role is based in San Francisco, CA, or New York, NY. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Independently manage assigned legal programs and workstreams: define plans, owners, milestones, and dependencies within agreed scope, anticipate blockers, and drive execution. - Translate counsel’s and specialist teams’ guidance into repeatable workflows, playbooks, and documentation. Depending on your portfolio, this may include intake, sensitive user escalations, information gathering, and response coordination. - Build strong partnerships across Legal, Product, Safety, User Operations, Policy, and other teams to clarify ownership, coordinate handoffs, and drive commitments through completion. - Clarify open questions, gather and verify information, synthesize partner input, and bring recommendations and tradeoffs to the appropriate decision-makers. Escalate decisions that require changes to priorities, scope, or resources. - Maintain a reliable source of truth for matters, source documents, owners, deadlines, decisions, and actions. Provide concise reporting on progress, blockers, and decisions needed. - Identify recurring issues and execution gaps, propose practical improvements, and lead agreed changes through implementation and adoption. Use tools and automation thoughtfully, verify outputs, and assess improvements in quality, timeliness, and partner effort. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have demonstrated experience independently managing programs or projects from planning through delivery in legal operations, business operations, compliance, policy, investigations, or a related field. - Have experience coordinating work across teams, maintaining reliable records, and driving open questions and actions to resolution. Experience working with an in-house legal team or in a technology environment is a plus. - Have improved a recurring workflow, documented the change, and helped others adopt it. You can explain what improved and how you assessed the result. - Take ownership of execution, set and achieve milestones, anticipate dependencies, and follow through without frequent direction. - Bring strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. Exercise sound judgment under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and know when to proceed independently or seek guidance. - Handle sensitive information and difficult subject matter with discretion and care, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and recognize when counsel or specialist input is needed. - Are resourceful and hands-on, with enthusiasm for AI technology and the ability to learn unfamiliar subject areas, use AI tools thoughtfully, and verify their outputs. - Bring familiarity with user safety, legal escalations, preservation, incident response, or operational data as a plus. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. Our mission is to bridge traditional commerce with Web3, enabling seamless checkout and funding experiences whether users pay via fiat (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay) or crypto (self-custodial wallets, Coinbase retail accounts, and stablecoins). You will drive the product roadmap for core offerings including our Payment Acceptance API, OAuth deep-linking integrations, and headless Onramp APIs. In this role, you will lead high-impact technical initiatives while collaborating closely with engineering, partner platforms, and payment service providers worldwide. You will play a pivotal role in expanding global merchant adoption and setting the benchmark for stablecoin and digital asset payments. What you’ll do: Serve as End-to-End Product DRI: Drive the full product lifecycle for the Pay suite, overseeing both the merchant portal and checkout user experience (authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, and subscriptions). Scale Core Payment Products: Expand and optimize the headless Onramp API, Coinbase OAuth retail funding flows, and merchant payment acceptance infrastructure to power frictionless fiat-to-crypto and stablecoin payments. Manage Strategic & BD Partnerships: Collaborate with cross-chain infrastructure providers (e.g., Across, Relay) to enable seamless multi-asset routing (such as USDT to USDC) and drive integrations with major commerce and PSP platforms (e.g., PPRO, Checkout.com). Bridge Fiat & Crypto Payment Rails: Architect unified checkout experiences that connect traditional payment rails (Apple Pay, Google Pay, debit/credit cards, bank transfers) with decentralized ecosystems, DeFi applications, and self-custodial wallets. Required Skills and Experience: Proven Experience in Global Payments: 6+ years of technical product management experience with a deep understanding of payment service providers (PSPs), acquiring, authorization/settlement mechanics, and merchant acquiring ecosystems. Global Regulatory & Licensing Acumen: Solid familiarity with cross-border payment regulations, fintech compliance, and international licensing frameworks across major regions such as the US, EU, and LatAm. API & Developer Product Expertise: Demonstrated success designing, launching, and scaling developer-facing products, headless APIs, SDKs, and deep-link/OAuth integration frameworks. Cross-Chain & Web3 Knowledge: Working understanding of crypto transactions, stablecoins, self-custodial wallets, and cross-chain bridge/liquidity protocols. Policy Advocacy turns Anthropic’s policy priorities into evidence-backed positions, research, campaigns, and partnerships — distinct from government relations and communications, but essential to enabling both. Strategic and systems thinkers that understand how individual positions and engagements fit together across the broader policy landscape are encouraged to apply. items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - SF
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems. About the role You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions. You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground. You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role you will: - Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria. - Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review. - Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false-positive rates. - Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence. - Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt. You might thrive in this role if you: - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software. - Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering. - Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows. - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security. - Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production-quality changes. - Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders. Additional experience Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas: - Security curiosity and experimentation: You read CVE write-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis—or prove a point—and enjoy turning a security question into a hands-on experiment. - Security community engagement: You enjoy exchanging ideas with defenders, whether that’s discussing security strategy with a CISO at Black Hat or comparing technical approaches with frontline practitioners. - Application security: You’ve written CodeQL queries or Semgrep rules, built fuzzing harnesses, or discovered and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities. - Automated remediation: CI/CD is your happy place. You’ve built tooling that turns security findings into tested patches, dependency upgrades, or configuration changes across large codebases. - Detection engineering: You’ve written and deployed detections using Sigma, YARA, Splunk, or KQL and tested them against attacker behavior. - Cloud and identity security: You’ve designed cloud IAM architectures and investigated abuse of workload identities, role hierarchies, or cross-account trust. - Security research: You’ve reverse-engineered malware, developed exploit reproductions, or contributed to vulnerability research. - Agent security: You’ve tested agents for prompt injection, tool misuse, or credential exposure and built defenses against them. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - NYC
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems. About the role You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions. You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground. You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it. This role is based in New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role you will: - Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria. - Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review. - Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false-positive rates. - Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence. - Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt. You might thrive in this role if you: - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software. - Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering. - Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows. - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security. - Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production-quality changes. - Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders. Additional experience Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas: - Security curiosity and experimentation: You read CVE write-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis—or prove a point—and enjoy turning a security question into a hands-on experiment. - Security community engagement: You enjoy exchanging ideas with defenders, whether that’s discussing security strategy with a CISO at Black Hat or comparing technical approaches with frontline practitioners. - Application security: You’ve written CodeQL queries or Semgrep rules, built fuzzing harnesses, or discovered and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities. - Automated remediation: CI/CD is your happy place. You’ve built tooling that turns security findings into tested patches, dependency upgrades, or configuration changes across large codebases. - Detection engineering: You’ve written and deployed detections using Sigma, YARA, Splunk, or KQL and tested them against attacker behavior. - Cloud and identity security: You’ve designed cloud IAM architectures and investigated abuse of workload identities, role hierarchies, or cross-account trust. - Security research: You’ve reverse-engineered malware, developed exploit reproductions, or contributed to vulnerability research. - Agent security: You’ve tested agents for prompt injection, tool misuse, or credential exposure and built defenses against them. items.title: Customer Experience Team Lead, RHM Executive Office
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood’s Customer Experience team plays a critical role in Democratizing Finance for All. Our customer experience team supports customers across a wide range of account needs, delivering timely, accurate, and empathetic support across multiple channels. As a Customer Experience Team Lead within the Executive Office, you will serve as a technical leader and subject matter expert, helping our team deliver accurate, timely, and thoughtful resolutions to complex customer concerns. You will provide hands-on coaching, strengthen investigative and problem-solving capabilities, and support consistent execution of our quality and regulatory standards. You’ll partner closely with the Customer Experience Manager to drive operational excellence, manage case priorities, and identify opportunities to improve processes and customer outcomes. This role requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to navigate sensitive situations while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Schedule & Work Environment This role is based in our Westlake, TX office or Denver, CO, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days a week. The team operates on a 7:00am - 10:00pm EST schedule . Employees will work either five 8-hour shifts or four 10-hour shifts per week, depending on business needs. Specific schedules will be determined after hire. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Serve as a technical subject matter expert, providing guidance and coaching on complex customer complaints, investigations, and escalations. Develop team capabilities through hands-on coaching, case reviews, knowledge sharing, and actionable feedback that strengthens quality, judgment, and resolution effectiveness. Support daily operations by monitoring case queues, prioritizing time-sensitive matters, and ensuring cases are assigned, progressed, and resolved within established service-level and regulatory timelines. Provide guidance on sensitive or high-risk customer situations, partnering with Compliance, Legal, and other internal teams to support appropriate resolution. Monitor case quality, productivity, and operational trends, identifying opportunities to improve team performance, processes, and the customer experience. Partner with the Customer Experience Manager to reinforce operational standards, drive accountability, and support continuous improvement initiatives. Lead by example by directly managing complex customer cases and supporting the team during periods of increased volume or operational need. What you bring Active FINRA Series 7, Series 63, Series 9/10 OR Series 24 preferred. Ability to obtain Series 3 within 120 days) Experience handling complex customer concerns, escalations, or complaints within a financial services or regulated environment. Strong technical coaching and leadership skills, with the ability to develop others through feedback, guidance, and knowledge sharing. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and professionally in sensitive or high-stakes situations. Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail. Sound judgment and the ability to balance customer outcomes, regulatory requirements, and business priorities. Proven ability to manage competing priorities, meet critical deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment. Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence outcomes without direct authority. Flexibility in scheduling to support business needs. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected hourly range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 2 compensation zones. This role is also eligible to participate in a Robinhood bonus plan. Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $44.20 — $52 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $39.10 — $46 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.description: About the Team OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood as it leaves the lab and meets the world. This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning. About the Role We’re looking for a San Francisco-based Content Maker to create social-first, platform-native content across OpenAI’s brand and product work. This role is for someone who can spot a good story, go capture it, and turn it into something sharp, clear, and engaging. You’ll be hands-on across the full content process: ideating, shooting, scripting, editing, and publishing-ready execution. This could include filming behind-the-scenes moments, capturing quick interviews, making short-form videos, editing social cuts, building lightweight content series, or helping translate complex ideas into formats that feel human and easy to understand. The right person has strong taste, moves quickly, knows how to shoot and edit, and understands how content behaves across social and digital platforms. You should be comfortable making work directly, not just directing it, and available to capture content in person in San Francisco as needed. In this role, you will: - Create social-first content across digital, editorial, and platform-native surfaces - Shoot, capture, and edit short-form video, interviews, behind-the-scenes content, and lightweight storytelling formats - Identify content opportunities in real time and move quickly to capture or create around them - Turn complex ideas, product moments, and company stories into clear, engaging content - Work hands-on across ideation, scripting, filming, editing, and execution - Develop platform-native concepts for social posts, reels, stories, creator-style content, and lightweight editorial - Partner with producers, designers, copywriters, marketers, and cross-functional teams to bring content from idea to final asset - Help shape narrative arcs across short-form and always-on content - Adapt tone, format, and pacing for different audiences and platforms - Stay close to internet culture, platform behaviors, social trends, and emerging formats to keep the work fresh and relevant You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 5+ years of relevant experience - Are based in San Francisco and available for in-person content capture as needed - Understand short-form video, social storytelling, pacing, hooks, and platform behavior - Are a true maker, comfortable shooting, editing, scripting, and building content directly - Have strong creative instincts and can quickly turn ideas into compelling content - Have experience creating content for social, digital, and platform-native environments - Know how to capture real moments and shape them into clear, engaging stories - Can balance speed, quality, and taste in a fast-moving environment - Have strong judgment around what feels culturally relevant, brand-right, and worth making - Are comfortable working independently and jumping in when there’s something to capture - Collaborate well with producers, designers, copywriters, marketers, creators, and external partners - Have a strong point of view on storytelling, internet culture, and how brands should show up in the world About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.
